name: FG-NET
description: Personalized marketing, age-based demographic analysis, and facial recognition systems are just a few of the many uses for accurate age prediction from facial photos. With the FG-NET dataset, a benchmark dataset frequently used for age estimation tasks, we investigate the usage of deep learning approaches for age prediction in this research. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are used in our method to extract meaningful representations from facial photos and forecast the related age labels. We upgrade the pretrained model on the FG-NET dataset using a cutting-edge architecture, such as VGGNet or ResNet, to enhance age prediction accuracy. We adhere to a strict experimental setup to achieve reliable evaluation. We have divided the FG-NET dataset into training, validation, and test sets, making sure that the age groups in each set were distributed equally.
